LanguageData.EarnedExperience_MasterEnabled_Desc: Master toggle for the entire XP system. Disable to restore pure vanilla behaviour without uninstalling.
LanguageData.EarnedExperience_GlobalMult_Desc: Multiplies XP for every supported activity. 1.0 = designed balance, 0 = no XP, 2.0 = twice as fast. Adjust if you find progression too slow or too fast overall.
LanguageData.EarnedExperience_Notifications_Desc: Display a subtle floating text near the pawn when they earn XP from a modded activity. Throttled to avoid spam.
LanguageData.EarnedExperience_DebugLog_Desc: Write detailed XP award info to the RimWorld log (developer mode). Useful for verifying balance or diagnosing issues.
LanguageData.EarnedExperience_Footer_Hint: Tip: Multiplier 0 disables XP for that activity. Skill assignment controls which skill receives the XP. Changes apply immediately and respect passion/learning limits.
LanguageData.EarnedExperience_Stonecutting_Desc: Cutting stone chunks into blocks at the stonecutting table. Vanilla awards no Crafting XP. This mod awards Crafting XP proportional to work ticks.
LanguageData.EarnedExperience_Smelting_Desc: Smelting weapons, apparel and other items at fueled/electric smelters. Vanilla awards no XP. Awards Crafting XP proportional to work ticks.
LanguageData.EarnedExperience_Cleaning_Desc: Cleaning dirt, blood and filth. No ideal vanilla skill exists; default is Crafting at 0.5x so dedicated cleaners still develop slowly. Reassign to any skill or disable.
LanguageData.EarnedExperience_Hauling_Desc: Moving resources, items and corpses between stockpiles. No ideal vanilla skill; default is Crafting at 0.5x. XP is awarded on successful haul completion based on distance and mass, clamped to prevent farming.
LanguageData.EarnedExperience_TransportLoading_Desc: Loading transport pods, caravans and shuttles. Awarded once per item loaded, with duplicate protection for multi-item jobs.
LanguageData.EarnedExperience_Refueling_Desc: Refueling generators, heaters, stoves and other buildings. Vanilla awards no XP. Awards Construction (configurable) proportional to work ticks.
LanguageData.EarnedExperience_TrapRearming_Desc: Rearming traps after activation. Vanilla awards no XP; trap construction does, but rearming is separate. Awards Crafting XP proportional to work.
LanguageData.EarnedExperience_Cremation_Desc: Burning corpses/apparel at the crematorium (Do_Bill job). Vanilla awards no XP. Awards Crafting XP proportional to work ticks.
LanguageData.EarnedExperience_Firefighting_Desc: Extinguishing fires (Beat Fire job). Vanilla awards no XP. Awards Construction XP proportional to work ticks.
LanguageData.EarnedExperience_PatientCare_Desc: Feeding incapacitated pawns and similar medical assistance. Only awarded if vanilla does not already award Medical XP for the specific action (vanilla tending/surgery already give Medical XP and are not duplicated).
